scenarios.name: baseline
scenarios.label: Baseline — business 10001 exactly as configured
scenarios.story: The control: a 30% inflow drop from week 18, one large transfer and one odd-hours sale.

scenarios.name: calm_counterfactual
scenarios.label: Calm half-year — no shock, no anomalies
scenarios.story: The same business if nothing had gone wrong.

scenarios.name: mild_slowdown
scenarios.label: Mild slowdown — inflows down 15% from week 18
scenarios.story: A soft market: customers spend a little less for the last two months.

scenarios.name: severe_collapse
scenarios.label: Severe revenue collapse — inflows down 60% from week 14
scenarios.story: A major customer segment disappears three months before the decision date.

scenarios.name: late_sudden_shock
scenarios.label: Late sudden shock — inflows down 70% in the final three weeks
scenarios.story: The shock lands just before the decision date: can anything see it yet?

scenarios.name: fraud_pattern
scenarios.label: Suspicious activity — repeated large transfers and night-time sales
scenarios.story: Revenue is normal, but money moves in ways the business never did before.

scenarios.name: combined_crisis
scenarios.label: Combined crisis — 60% revenue collapse from week 12 plus large transfers out
scenarios.story: Revenue collapses and cash is moved out of the business at the same time.

scenarios.name: thin_file_newcomer
scenarios.label: Newcomer — trading for about 40 days only
scenarios.story: A business too new to judge: the system must refuse, not guess.
